name: @joanreyero/oats-whatsapp
description: OATS capability package oats.whatsapp: a WhatsApp chat between a human and a resident OATS instance (Kapso, official Cloud API; wacli as the local adapter). OATS resolves it from this repository's git tag; this npm package is a mirror of the same payload.
